en: Proverbs 2

p.src: 1  My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,

en: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,
u.src: 1  My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,

p.src: 2  so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;

en: so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;
u.src: 2  so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;

p.src: 3  yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;

en: yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;
u.src: 3  yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;

p.src: 4  if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures;

en: if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures;
u.src: 4  if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures;

p.src: 5  then you will understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.

en: then you will understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.
u.src: 5  then you will understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.

ja: 2:5 「神」と訳されたヘブライ語は「אֱלֹהִים」（エロヒム）である。
en: 2:5 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “אֱלֹהִ֑ים” (Elohim).

p.src: 6  For the LORD gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

en: For the LORD gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
u.src: 6  For the LORD gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

p.src: 7  He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,

en: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,
u.src: 7  He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,

p.src: 8  that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.

en: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.
u.src: 8  that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.

p.src: 9  Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.

en: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.
u.src: 9  Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.

p.src: 10  For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

en: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
u.src: 10  For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

p.src: 11  Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,

en: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,
u.src: 11  Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,

p.src: 12  to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,

ja: から、 曲がったことを
en: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,
u.src: 12  to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,

p.src: 13  who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,

en: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,
u.src: 13  who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,

p.src: 14  who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil,

en: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil,
u.src: 14  who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil,

p.src: 15  who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths,

ja: みは正道からそれている。
en: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths,
u.src: 15  who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths,

p.src: 16  to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,

en: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,
u.src: 16  to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,

p.src: 17  who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;

en: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;
u.src: 17  who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;

p.src: 18  for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.

en: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.
u.src: 18  for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.

p.src: 19  None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.

en: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.
u.src: 19  None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.

p.src: 20  Therefore walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

ja: それゆえ、善良な者たちの
en: Therefore walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
u.src: 20  Therefore walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

p.src: 21  For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.

ja: み、 潔白な者はそこにとどまる。
en: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.
u.src: 21  For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.

p.src: 22  But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.

ja: はそこから根こそぎにされる。
en: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.
u.src: 22  But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.
